newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amnuay leads Thai bond U.S. roadshow on April 6-9.
newsitem.headline: Amnuay leads Thai bond U.S. roadshow on April 6-9.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan is scheduled to lead a U.S. roadshow on Thailand's $500 million Yankee bonds on April 6-9, a finance ministry source said on Thursday.
The source said Amnuay, accompanied by advisers including Viroj Nualkhair, chief executive of brokerage firm Phatra Thanakit Plc, will begin the roadshow in Washington, D.C.

The official voiced confidence that market sentiment on the Thai 30/100-year bonds will not be hurt by recent bearish reports on stability of Thai financial institutions because of their exposure to the troubled Thai property sector.
He said the roadshow is being arranged by Lehman Brothers and Salomon Brothers.
